name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Fetched the quickstart page, installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example script, and successfully generated an MP3 audio file from text using the ElevenLabs API. The output.mp3 file (46,019 bytes) was verified as a valid MPEG ADTS layer III audio file at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural using the `file` command.
deviations: The quickstart instructs to play audio through speakers using `play(audio)`, but the sandbox has no audio output capability. To verify the promised outcome (generating an audio file from text), I created a second script that writes the audio stream to output.mp3 instead of playing it. This is the only deviation — all other steps (SDK installation, API key usage via ELEVENLABS_API_KEY env var, voice_id, model_id, output_format) followed the quickstart exactly.
